subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should this work land as a staged optimization that handles profile summaries, membership summaries, and indexed pagination first, with the display-manifest path tracked separately, or as one comprehensive publisher-read rewrite?
rationale: Both approaches can satisfy the performance goal, but the display-manifest behavior and breadth of the first implementation determine review scope, migration risk, and whether one autonomous change remains reasonably bounded.

options.title: Stage the bounded reads
options.body: Land the summary and indexed-pagination changes first while preserving legacy fallbacks, then track the display-manifest redesign as a focused follow-up.

options.title: Require one complete rewrite
options.body: Keep all four read paths together and do not consider the issue resolved until the display manifest is also demonstrably bounded.

recommendation.title: Stage the bounded reads
recommendation.body: Land the summary and indexed-pagination changes first while preserving legacy fallbacks, then track the display-manifest redesign as a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor most directly connected to the publisher profile and catalog behavior and supplied the proposed subsystem boundaries.
